top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards an original, mature and independently confirmed chain of discovery, from human incretin physiology and proglucagon processing to the bioactive GLP-1(7-36) peptide, which underpins therapies with randomized outcome evidence in glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal disease. A physiology-centred citation keeps the award within physiology or medicine and makes the omission of analogue design a stated principle. The residual risk is the Mojsov versus Habener priority question, which the supplied record cannot settle, but this does not justify withholding the prize, so no award ranks last.
